about: What each r/unixporn screenshot shows about its terminals, looked at once. Facts only; screenshots are linked from the dataset, never stored here.

entries.note: No terminal anywhere: a pink anime wallpaper with shell widgets (weather, calendar, to-do, palette) and side docks.
Two small overlapping dark windows, a cyan and pink visualizer over a track list; tidy and legible, but dwarfed by the big widgets and start page around them.
No terminal: pastel pink and purple desktop with a sidebar widget, a file manager and an image viewer.
Tmux-style window stacking a music list, a cyan visualizer strip and a nano buffer over a blurred wallpaper; nicely layered, though the text is dense and small.
Only a tiny dark fetch window in an overview thumbnail; the rest is a bright blue settings panel and wallpapers, so the terminal barely registers.
Single small dark fetch window with a green leaf logo, floating over a warm forest wallpaper; readable and quiet, but the file manager and IDE take most of the attention.
No terminal: light pastel desktop built from widget cards, a launcher and a bar; the small fetch and visualizer are widgets, not windows.
A startup-script wall of translucent windows: fetch, weather, matrix rain, a visualizer and a big gradient banner on top; striking, with the banner washing out the fetch text behind it.
Photo of an ultrawide desk in the GNOME overview; a fetch window and a btop window are visible only as tiny thumbnails, so the terminal part is barely readable.
One small dark fetch window with traffic-light buttons, calm and matching the navy desktop; the terminal is a minor extra next to the dashboard and widgets.
